summary: Original APDG uses supplied native params; public quadratic gradient and rank-deficient constraint embedding retain original core methods and exact source states.
scope_notes: Inspected apdg and model objective/gradient/A operators directly. Public-only readonly smoke completed both cases; no numeric comparison.
Initial x/fast-x and y/fast-y/previous-y are injected once before the loop; later states are only observed. Native float dtype, update order and stopping branches retained.

The regenerated problem objective differs only by residual expansion constant; measured public objective at true x has that irrelevant constant removed. Cached constructor optimum is diagnostic-only and is not a stopping criterion.
B is embedded with a zero redundant row per node; dual indices [0,2,4,5,6,7] preserve A, A^T, ATA and AAT. All public parameters pass through the native params interface.

substitutions.reason: Public quadratic coefficients and constraints replace generated objective/linear-map data; original gradient executes.
Writes only the initial states required by public inputs.
Copies source local arrays after updates; evaluates declared objective at actual x without manufacturing a trajectory.
Redundant zero constraint rows preserve original square-B operator protocol.
